subject: HP Care Research: scoped retention & consented TTL for debug traces (SIG/CAIQ evidence request)
messages:
From: Dr. Maya Patel <maya.patel@hpcare-research.org>
To: chloe_martin
Cc: kimberly_park
Date: 2026-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retention ask: research-consented TTL for debug traces + SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. A quick follow-up from our GRC and research team: for a small cohort of patients enrolled in an IRB-approved study we need the ability to extend tenant-level debug trace retention to 180 days (standard tenant TTL is 30 days). This is a compliance-driven request tied to documented consent and auditability.

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood provide a scoped retention matrix that shows which telemetry and debug artifacts can be retained (traces, session logs, api-audit, kv-cache metadata) and which are considered ephemeral?
- We need SIG/CAIQ control mappings that indicate how retention configuration, proof-of-delete, and key management are handled for tenant-scoped TTL exceptions.
- Sample proof-of-delete playbook or checklist you would provide if we need to evidence erasure to auditors.

We're collecting artifacts for a review on July 6th. Can you confirm feasibility and what evidence you can share ahead of the meeting?

Thanks,
Maya
Dr. Maya Patel
Director, Clinical Research IT
HP Care Research

Attachments referenced: none in this email

From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Maya Patel <maya.patel@hpcare-research.org>
Cc: kimberly_park, ben_carter, priyom_das
Date: 2026-06-27T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention ask: research-consented TTL for debug traces + SIG/CAIQ evidence

Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can support a bounded exception path for consented research cohorts; wanted to outline an initial plan and deliverables so we can align before your July 6 review.

Proposed deliverables (we will send drafts by 2026-06-29):
1) Scoped retention matrix (attached: hpcr_retention_matrix_v1.xlsx) — maps artifacts to retention buckets (30d default / 180d research-cohort / permanent audit).
2) SIG/CAIQ mapping (attached: sig_caiq_mapping.pdf) — focused on controls related to retention config, KM lifecycle, and deletion verification; redlines for confidential items omitted.
3) Proof-of-delete playbook (attached: proof_of_delete_playbook_draft.docx) — steps we take to validate erasure and export deliverables for auditors.

Operational notes:
- Extended TTL will be tenant-scoped; we will require a signed mutual action plan and the cohort identifiers.
- Data will remain in encrypted form; for extended retention we recommend pseudonymization of PII fields — we can provide a recommended transform.
- For legal holds: any legal/IRB holds will supersede TTL and we have a documented hold/unhold workflow.

Next steps:
- Internal alignment: Kim / Ben / Priyom, please review attached matrix and flag any controls we cannot meet by 6/29.
- Maya, can you share the IRB consent language and a short list of the artifact types you need retained? If you prefer, let's block 30 minutes next week to walk the matrix.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hpcr_retention_matrix_v1.xlsx (attachment), sig_caiq_mapping.pdf (attachment), proof_of_delete_playbook_draft.docx (attachment)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: chloe_martin, ben_carter, priyom_das
Date: 2026-06-28T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: mapping questions + KMS/erase semantics (do not forward)

Folks — quick internal checklist before we send final drafts to HP Care Research:

1) Artifact classification: we need engineering confirmation on which of the following are retained as part of "debug traces":
   - request/response payloads (full/partial)
   - KV-cache eviction metadata
   - streaming token-level debug logs
   - inference server audit events (auth/access/change)
2) Proof-of-delete options: we can provide (a) cryptographic deletion attestation for object stores, (b) retention log showing deletion timestamps + job run ids, (c) sample export of deleted-object manifests. Which combination is stronger for SIG auditors?
3) KMS: confirm whether extended-ttl objects are encrypted with tenant-key and whether key-rotation or key-destroy will be used as a deletion mechanism (note: key destroy impacts all tenant data).

Action items: Ben — please pull a sample (anonymized) retention export for a tenant with 30d vs 180d TTL so we can validate the playbook steps. Priyom — please sanity-check the draft CAIQ mappings and flag any low-level control gaps (esp. CC6/CC7 equivalents).

Once we have these we can produce the finalized artifact packet for Maya.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Quoted above: Chloe's draft attachments and Maya's original request

From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Maya Patel <maya.patel@hpcare-research.org>, Ava Sullivan <ava.sullivan@hpcare-research.org>, Oliver Trent <oliver.trent@hpcare-research.org>
Cc: kimberly_park, ben_carter, priyom_das
Date: 2026-06-29T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention ask: research-consented TTL for debug traces + SIG/CAIQ evidence (deliverables and next steps)

Maya / Ava / Oliver — following internal review, please find a consolidated response and next steps. I attached the artifacts we discussed and included a short summary below.

Summary of what we can provide by 2026-06-29:
- Finalized Scoped Retention Matrix (see attachment) — indicates which telemetry types can be retained to 180 days and recommends pseudonymization rules for PII.
- SIG/CAIQ control mapping (redacted where necessary) — highlights controls covering retention configuration, role-based change approvals, and deletion verification steps.
- Proof-of-delete playbook (draft) — step-by-step checklist plus sample export format for auditors.

Operational items / asks from HP Care Research:
1) Signed mutual action plan that lists the tenant IDs and the consented cohort. We cannot apply tenant-scoped TTL without an authorized request.
2) Confirmation that IRB consent includes storage of de-identified debug artifacts for up to 180 days.
3) Any legal hold triggers should be routed to legal@hpcare-research.org and we will mark the tenant accordingly.

We propose a 30-minute workshop on 2026-07-01 at 10:00 AM PT to walk the matrix and the playbook. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Links to artifacts (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHPCR-retention and ticket SUP-4572.

If you'd like, we can redact sample records for the packet delivered to auditors.

Best regards,
